params.2184:
This monstrosity is a clever machine made from various nautical objects by Mi-Gor the undead surgeon pirate. No, really...

Quest: The Great Brain Robbery

Combat: This weird contraption will perform melee damage, but also reduces your Defence, Attack, Ranged and Magic stats if you don't have high enough crush defence. He will also reduce your prayer points and turn off any active prayers.
